mapper.select: /* 내 관심상품 목록 카테고리 조회 */ SELECT DISTINCT pc.middle_category FROM customer c INNER JOIN wishlist w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id LEFT JOIN products p ON w.products_no = p.products_no INNER JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no INNER JOIN sell_products sp ON p.products_no = sp.products_no WHERE w.cust_id = #{customerId};

/* 내 관심상품 목록 조회 */ SELECT DISTINCT w.wishlist_no , c.cust_id , w.products_no , p.products_image , p.products_nm , pc.middle_category , w.register_date, MIN(sp.final_price) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.products_no) AS minimumRentalFee, IFNULL(MIN(CASE WHEN sp.period = 0 THEN sp.final_price END) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.products_no), 0) AS minimumPrice FROM customer c INNER JOIN wishlist w ON c.cust_id = w.cust_id LEFT JOIN products p ON w.products_no = p.products_no INNER JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no INNER JOIN sell_products sp ON sp.products_no = w.products_no WHERE w.cust_id = #{custId}
AND pc.middle_category = #{viewValue}
